I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) within [utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/utils.py).

### Root Cause
When [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) was updated to use `urllib3.util.parse_url` instead of `urllib.parse.urlparse`, `parsed.netloc` only included `host` and `port` without `auth`. As a result, calling [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) on a proxy URL in [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) stripped the authentication credentials before `Proxy-Authorization` headers were generated.

### Fix
- Reconstructed `netloc` with `auth` (`'@'.join([auth, netloc])`) when `auth` is present in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-k92dk2u9/requests/utils.py#L977-L978).
